label: Circular Room
literalRoomDescription: This is a damp circular room, whose walls are made of brick and mortar. The roof of this room is not visible, but there appear to be some etchings on the walls. There is a passageway to the west.
safeSceneProfile: Damp circular brick-and-mortar chamber with roof out of sight and separate wall etchings; west passage. Bucket movement is source-controlled.

label: Top of Well
literalRoomDescription: You are at the top of the well. Well done. There are etchings on the side of the well. There is a small crack across the floor at the entrance to a room on the east, but it can be crossed easily.
safeSceneProfile: Top of well with side etchings and easily crossed floor crack at eastern room entrance. No invented fatal crack or guessed sky.
